title: Arcat Vanilla+
description: A modpack that attempts to Enhance the vanilla aspects of the game, adding more variations of already existing blocks, Quality of life features, rework of World generation and adding vanilla friendly features that use existing items and enhance  the game
body:
Arcat Vanilla+ is a modpack that attempts to Enhance/Improve already existing minecraft features without adding too many new unrelated stuff to keep The game vanilla friendly.

I highly recommend getting Photon Shaders with Voxy support! Voxy doesn't work with too many shaders for now

Some of the features
- Various Optimization mods
- various quality of life features like rebalancing of Item stacks with Sensible Stackables
- Voxy, Lod mod that adds Level of depth to minecraft that allows for much higher render distance, seeing chunks Far far away without sacrificing performance 
- reworked Terrain generation with mods like Continents,Tectonic, Amplified Nether, Nullscape and various other mods that Add new biomes to all 3 dimensions, overworld, nether and end. also adding many new structures also to all 3 dimensions
- Vertical slabs!
- mobs from mob votes, and various other vanilla friendly mobs from Animal Garden mod series!
- adding new variations of already existing blocks like Glass stairs, for better building
- New enchants and improved enchanting with Easy magic, Enchants plus and TimberEnchantment addon adding timber mod through new enchantment to the game 
- adding one new set of Armor tools and weapons filling up the gap in progression between Iron and diamond with mod: Rose Gold equipment 
- Fletching table finally having a use! Expanded archery with few mods that add Quiver, adding new variations of arrows, like diamond arrows or Iron arrows with mods like Arrow+, Archery things and FletchingRecipe. 
- Trims for tools! with mod Tool trims mod, piglins treating golden armor trims same as gold armor with Respect my trims, trims now being more than just visual but also functional with Armor Trim effects
- Accessories and Accessorify mods to bring accessories to minecraft using already existing items!
- and many more smaller mods that add a lot of charm to the game!
